summary: Braskem S.A. filed a Form 6-K to disclose its Internal Rules of the Executive Board (Conselho de Administração), a routine governance document. The rules cover composition, term of office, replacement procedures, and competencies of executive officers, with no transactional or special-situation content. This is a regulatory filing of corporate governance policies, not an event-driven special situation. As a foreign private issuer, the 6-K serves to furnish information equivalent to an 8-K for governance updates. No deal terms, activism, restructuring, or strategic change is present. Watch for any subsequent operational or financial disclosures.
